preamble.summary: 2 Samuel 12 contains Nathan's parable of the ewe lamb, David's confession ('I have sinned against the LORD'), the death of the child, and the birth of Solomon. 4QSamᵃ preserves portions with minor variants.
preamble.notable_variants: Minor wording variants. David's confession (v. 13) and Nathan's prophetic-judgment formula track MT.

variant_notes: David's terse confession 'I have sinned against the LORD' (chatati la-YHWH) tracks MT. The Psalm 51 superscription connects the psalm to this moment.
